findings.message: Every error from `Rename` becomes a 500, including the not-found case. For an unknown id the UPDATE matches no rows and the follow-up `s.Widget` lookup fails, so the client gets 500 instead of the required 404.

`Rename` ignores `RowsAffected`, so a missing widget is only noticed by the follow-up read. That read is a separate, non-atomic query, so the not-found signal depends on whatever error `s.Widget` returns rather than an explicit not-found error the handler can map to 404.

criteria.note: Implemented, but no test exercises the rename endpoint.
An unknown id falls into the generic error path and returns 500, not 404. No test covers it.
